change_summary: Add hybrid routing that downgrades mechanical order-lookup/identity-verification turns to gpt-4.1-mini while keeping gpt-4.1 for reasoning-critical turns.
reason_for_change: The cost driver is 40 repeated get_order_details/identity-verification turns that are simple pattern-matching. Routing only those mechanical turns to gpt-4.1-mini cuts token cost on the bulk of turns, while reasoning/decision turns (return/exchange/cancel/policy) stay on gpt-4.1 to hold success above the floor — avoiding the full-mini failure that swapped every turn. Routing fails safe to gpt-4.1 whenever the turn cannot be confidently classified as mechanical.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.582666 >= threshold 0.549781 (best mean 0.580574 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The dominant cost driver is repeated per-order get_order_details calls (40 across run) triggered by users not supplying order IDs; a hybrid routing that keeps gpt-4.1 for reasoning-critical turns but uses gpt-4.1-mini for the many mechanical order-enumeration/lookup turns will cut cost without dropping success (prior full-mini route failed because it swapped ALL turns).
